reason: Every client I have came from someone else's recommendation, and the offer itself says it will not bring me clients, so I would be paying 2,400 plus 140 a month for a site nobody asked me for. The document-upload part is the only thing that speaks to my week, but my farmers phone me or hand me paper at the gate; they will not click a secure link.
objection: The founder does this 10-12 hours a week next to a day job, and the launch discount is offered in exchange for a case study, which tells me nobody in Romania is using it yet. I am not going to be the experiment on a 12-month contract.
would_change_my_mind: A grant consultant in Bihor or Bucharest I can phone, who has run the document automation for at least a year with farmer and SME clients and tells me the chasing really dropped.
